supportResults.prompt: How do I add a new client to my account?
supportResults.answer:
To add a new client to your account, follow these steps:

1. Log in to your TEKANGO account.
2. Navigate to the "Clients" section from the dashboard.
3. Click on the "Add New Client" button.
4. Fill in the required client information and save it.

This will create a new client profile in your account. If you need further assistance, feel free to ask!
